# breaking the crafter closes the menu
MENU A cid=0 type=inventory state=1 carried=empty
MS 36 minecraft:oak_log*4
MS 37 minecraft:oak_planks*16
MS 44 minecraft:stick*4
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 140112000400
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 140113002d00
PKT A minecraft:container_close 1101
